# libuv 1.53.0

Source: https://dist.libuv.org/dist/v1.53.0/libuv-v1.53.0.tar.gz

Release: https://github.com/libuv/libuv/releases/tag/v1.53.0 (2026-09-24).
Archive SHA-256: `cb0d6dd2128d5a95bd242c6cc982a24fe608fa93da57b6b4ec763b0018c53e64`.

Unmodified headers and source files selected from the upstream CMakeLists.txt
for Darwin and Linux. LICENSE and AUTHORS are preserved. Cone.toml lists the
translation units, definitions and system libraries explicitly. No generated
configure output or system libuv is required. The shim does not enable io_uring.
